gaps.sentence: He made a ___ mistake and lost all the data (CARE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -less means without: careless means not taking care. It modifies the noun 'mistake'.

gaps.sentence: The island is ___ , with no permanent residents (HABIT).
gaps.explanation: 'No permanent residents' shows the negative: uninhabited (un- + inhabited). An adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.sentence: The instructions were so ___ that nobody could follow them (CONFUSE).
gaps.explanation: Things that cause a feeling take -ing: confusing instructions. 'Confused' describes the people who feel it.

gaps.sentence: The old factory will be ___ into flats (MODERN).
gaps.hint: verb needed in the passive (-ise); past participle
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ise forms the verb: modernise. The passive 'will be' needs the past participle 'modernised'.

gaps.sentence: He lost his job because of his ___ (HONESTY).
gaps.hint: negative noun needed — he lost his job
gaps.explanation: Losing a job implies wrongdoing, so the negative noun 'dishonesty' (dis- + honesty) is needed.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (INVENT) of the new engine worked day and night.
gaps.explanation: The person who worked day and night is the inventor; 'invention' is the thing created.

gaps.sentence: The crisis could ___ the economic situation (WORSE).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -en forms the verb: worsen means to make worse. A base verb follows 'could'.

gaps.sentence: The meeting has been ___ until Thursday (SCHEDULE).
gaps.hint: arranged for a new time (re-); past participle needed
gaps.explanation: The prefix re- means again/afresh: rescheduled means given a new time. The passive needs the past participle.
